The meeting must be scheduled on Monday between 9:00 and 17:00 for 30 minutes, and Margaret cannot meet before 14:30. After analyzing the busy times for all participants, the only available 30-minute slot where everyone is free and Margaret's preference is satisfied is from 15:30 to 16:00.

- Shirley is free after 12:30, so available at 15:30-16:00.
- Jacob is free after 15:00, so available at 15:30-16:00.
- Stephen is free after 13:00, so available at 15:30-16:00.
- Margaret is free from 15:30 to 16:30 (after her 15:00-15:30 meeting and before her 16:30-17:00 meeting), and this time is after 14:30, satisfying her preference.
- Mason is free from 14:30 to 16:30 (after his 14:00-14:30 meeting and before his 16:30-17:00 meeting), so available at 15:30-16:00.

No other 30-minute slot between 14:30 and 17:00 works due to conflicts:
- 14:30-15:00: Jacob is busy (14:30-15:00).
- 15:00-15:30: Margaret is busy (15:00-15:30).
- 16:00-16:30: Possible, but 15:30-16:00 is chosen to avoid ending exactly at 16:30 when Margaret and Mason have meetings starting, though it would technically work if back-to-back meetings are allowed. However, 15:30-16:00 is equally available and avoids potential tight scheduling.

Thus, the meeting is scheduled for Monday from 15:30 to 16:00.
